manifest.name: dsh-tick
manifest.description: Session-local scheduled tasks for DeepSeek Harness: inject a prompt into the current session after a delay, at a fixed time, or on a repeating interval — with a Web management panel, a /schedule command, and model-facing management tools. State lives in the plugin's own folder; nothing is written to the session log.

summary.en: Schedule work inside a session: run a prompt after a delay, at a fixed time, or on a repeating interval. Manage tasks from a panel above the composer, the /schedule command, or the model's own tools.
summary.zh: 在会话内安排定时任务：延迟、固定时刻或按间隔重复执行一段提示词。可用输入框上方面板、/schedule 命令、以及模型自己的工具来管理。

manifest.author: Saretheya

bundle.text:
# dsh-tick 的 bundle 装配层（Tick / 定时任务）。
#
# 为什么用 bundle 自带 patch 而不是在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里手写 insert 行：
#   profile 里手写的 insert 行 **不会被 `dsh plugin remove` 清理**（dsh 只改
#   package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles，从不改写 cordis.patch.yml）。
#   于是"卸载插件但漏删那一行"会让 DSH 启动时 import 一个已不存在的包，
#   直接 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND、整个 profile 加载失败、Web UI 起不来（已实测）。
#   改用 bundle 装配后：`dsh plugin remove` 会把本包移出 bundles，
#   本文件随之不再被加载 —— 卸载即一条命令，不留悬空行。
#
# 注意：**刻意不挂载官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule**。
#   官方那套是**宿主级持久提醒**（跨会话、可唤醒冷会话，默认 disabled），
#   本插件是**会话内定时任务**。两者定位不同，同时开启会让用户与 AI 面对两套定时系统。
#   故本插件自建一套调度，专注做好这一件事。
- insert:
    - id: tick
      name: 'dsh-tick'

readme.text: <div align="center">

**在 DSH 会话里安排定时任务：到点后自动向当前会话注入一段提示词，唤醒模型去执行。** [English](README.en.md) · **中文** [](#安装) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-tick) 输入框上方的折叠摘要行 —— 点它展开即可管理任务。 ---

你想让 AI「5 分钟后检查一下构建队列」、「今晚 11 点汇总今天的工作」、
或者「每隔 10 分钟看一眼部署状态」——**说一次就行，到点它自己会做**。

dsh-tick 把定时能力做进**当前会话**：到点后，你设定的那段提示词会被注入会话，
唤醒模型执行。任务存在会话自己名下，**不会串到别的会话**。

---

| 模式 | 你怎么说 | 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| **延迟** | 「2 分钟后检查构建队列」 | 倒计时结束后执行一次 |
| **固定时刻** | 「今天 23:00 汇总工作」 | 到那个时刻执行一次 |
| **重复** | 「每 30 分钟看一眼部署」 | 按固定间隔反复触发，直到你暂停或删除 |

> **延时上限 30 天**（超过会被拒绝，并提示你改用固定时刻模式）；**周期不限时长**。
> 想等更久，请用「固定时刻」模式指定一个绝对时刻。
>
> 小提示：周期间隔想设得很长时请留意——DSH 关闭期间计时会冻结，
> 想让周期任务严格按间隔跑，得让它一直开着。

---

同一批任务，随你用哪种方式管：

1. **输入框上方的面板** —— 点开就能看剩余时间、暂停、编辑、删除；
2. **`/schedule` 命令** —— 不用打开面板，在聊天框里直接建；
3. **让 AI 自己管** —— 你的助手可以直接创建、查询、暂停、删除任务。

```
/schedule +30m 检查构建队列
/schedule +2h30m 汇总今天的改动
/schedule every 10m 看一眼部署状态
/schedule @2026-09-21T09:00:00+08:00 早会前汇总未完成项

> 时长写法用 `s` / `m` / `h`（例如 `+30m`、`+2h30m`），也接受中文
> 「秒 / 分钟 / 小时」（例如 `+30分钟`、`+1小时`）。**不支持 `d`（天）**——
> 要等一天以上，用「固定时刻」模式给一个绝对时刻更稳妥。

---

**暂停与恢复会冻结剩余时间**：暂停一个还剩 4 分钟的任务，明天再恢复，
它仍然等 4 分钟——不会因为过了一夜就立刻触发。

**DSH 关掉时计时冻结**（延迟与重复模式）。重新打开后任务会变成已暂停状态，
**不会在你不在的时候突然触发**。固定时刻的任务如果在那期间到点了，
会标记为**已超时**并等你处理。

上图里三行分别是：**已暂停**（重复任务）、**已超时**（固定时刻，跨重启错过的）、
**已暂停**（延迟）。侧栏底部的红点数字是所有会话里的超时总数。

**已超时的任务点一次播放按钮就等于「立即执行」**——不会另外再等时间。

---

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tick
```

装好后重启 DSH 即可。

> 需要 DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` 以上（**0.1.5 与 0.2.0 均已实测支持**，见下方「兼容的 DSH 版本」）。
> 插件**不修改** `settings.yaml`，卸载时随插件目录一起消失，不留残留。

---

插件自带一个配置文件（在插件自己的目录下，**不写进 DSH 的 settings**）：

```jsonc
{
  // 注入给模型的提示词用什么语言：'en'（默认）| 'zh' | 'custom'
  "serverPromptLanguage": "en",

> ⚠️ **三道闸默认是保守值**（`maxTasksPerSession: 50`、`maxActivePerSession: 10`、
> `maxInjectionsPerMinute: 1`）。它们的作用是**兜住 AI 的批量误建与自我循环**，
> 不是性能限制。日常使用如果觉得紧，**直接改大即可**——这是给你自己的安全绳，
> 不是产品硬约束。
>
> 这些配置项**改完即生效**，无需重启 DSH。

决定**模型看到的提示词**用什么语言，**与界面语言相互独立**：

| 取值 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| `"en"`（**默认**） | 英文 |
| `"zh"` | 中文 |
| `"custom"` | 用你自己的模板 |

默认英文是与 DSH 官方 goal / todo / schedule 保持一致的做法——
它们的界面有中英双语，但**注入给模型的提示词始终是英文**。

选 `custom` 后会生成一份带完整中文注释的模板文件，**改完即生效、无需重启**。
若该文件损坏，插件会把它改名保留为 `.bad-<时间戳>`、重新生成为初始模板，
并在对话窗口提示一次。

---

面板、侧栏、`/schedule` 回执都会跟随 **DSH 的语言设置**
（设置 → 通用 → 语言），中文 / English 都支持。
未做过语言选择时默认中文。

> 注入给模型的提示词用的是上面的 `serverPromptLanguage`，
> 与界面语言**互不影响**。

---

- **不往会话日志里写自定义事件**：任务状态存在插件自己的目录里。
  DSH 的会话日志有事件类型白名单，插件没有公开途径登记自己的类型。
- **注入消息标记为插件来源**，不伪装成用户发言。会话记录里始终能区分
  「你说的」与「定时器注入的」。
- **不占用官方 `dsh-schedule`**：官方那套是**宿主级持久提醒**（跨会话、可唤醒冷会话），
  本插件是**会话内定时任务**。两者定位不同，同时开启会让你和 AI 面对两套定时系统。

---

readme.section: 附：为什么没有「会话行内」的图标
readme.text:
**会话列表里不会出现定时任务的图标。这不是遗漏，而是官方机制本身做不到。**

DSH 的侧栏只开放 6 个插槽，其中会话列表区 `sidebar.workspaces` 是 **`single`**
插槽且已被官方独占：`single` 的语义是"渲染优先级胜者"，
**第二个注册者是替换而非并列**，无法增量添加；而会话行内部**没有** slot 渲染点。

唯一可行的路径是 DOM 注入（依赖压缩后的哈希类名），改版即碎、失效时还静默无提示，
代价大于收益，故不做。官方 goal 与 todo 也没有会话行内图标。

**替代品：侧栏底部的跨会话汇总入口**（即 `showSidebarSummary`，默认关闭）。
打开后它会显示所有会话的待执行 / 已超时总数，点开可展开跨会话列表并跳转。
用的是官方 `sidebar.footer.action` 插槽，零 DOM 依赖——把上面配置里的
`showSidebarSummary` 改为 `true` 即可。

---

- **计时依赖 DSH 运行**：延迟与重复模式在 DSH 关闭期间**冻结计时**，
  需要它按真实时间流逝的话，得保持 DSH 开启。
- **不扫描历史积压**：DSH 关闭期间错过的重复轮次**全部丢弃**，不会在重开后补跑。
- **注入频率默认每分钟 1 次**（`maxInjectionsPerMinute`）：
  设了比这更短的周期，实际触发会被限流。要跑更快就调大这个值。
- **时长不支持 `d`（天）**：用 `h`（如 `+48h`）或「固定时刻」模式。

---

**① 新增「允许后台唤醒」配置项（默认开启）**

以前任务到期时，如果目标会话**没有在界面上打开**，插件拿不到该会话的执行主体，
于是只能等你点开会话之后才"突然一起触发"。

现在默认会在任务到期时**主动唤醒该会话**并准时投递。这走的是官方
`sessionController.resolveAgent()`（契约原文：*Resolve or resume one ordinary Session*），
与官方 `dsh-schedule` 的做法一致。

若你希望插件保持安静、只在已打开的会话里投递，把 `data/config.json` 的
`allowBackgroundWake` 改为 `false` 即可——此时任务不会丢，仍保持逾期状态，
等你打开会话后照常触发。

**② 修复收起状态下倒计时不刷新**

输入框上方的折叠摘要行本来就在显示"下一个任务还有多久"，但此前只有**展开**时才
每秒刷新，收起时数字会僵住直到下一次轮询。现在只要存在待执行任务，收起状态也会
每秒正常走字（只重渲染，不发请求）。

---

**症状**：升级到 DSH 0.2.1 后，任务到点触发时整轮报错：

```
本轮运行失败  format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind
```

**原因**：0.2.1 启用了会话格式 v4，**废弃了消息来源的 `kind: 'plugin'` 写法**，
改为要求「生产者自有的 kind」。插件原先注入的 `{ kind: 'plugin', plugin: 'tick' }`
正好是被拒绝的那一种，因此**注入这一步失败**（任务本身能正常计时、正常标记完成，
只有"把提示词送进会话"这一环挂了）。

**修复**：改用 `{ kind: 'plugin:tick' }`。这个形状不是随手取的，而是
**DSH 自己把旧数据迁移到 v4 时产生的同一种形状**（迁移函数对 `plugin:'tick'`
就是返回 `plugin:tick`），所以与官方语义完全一致。会话记录里仍能一眼认出
「这是插件注入的」，也**绝不会**被误当成你的发言。

**兼容性**（同一份代码，无需按版本装不同包）：

| DSH 版本 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| **0.1.5-rc.2** | ✅ 支持（该版对消息来源无运行期校验）|
| **0.2.0** | ✅ 支持（该版已可用 `describe()` 读配置，见下）|
| **0.2.1-rc.5** | ✅ 支持（即本次修复的目标版本）|

跨版本能力检测自动选路，**不依赖版本号**：

| | 0.1.x | 0.2.x |
|---|---|---|
| 读界面语言 | `settings.get('locale')` | `settings.describe()`（`get` 已被移除）|
| 语言变更通知 | `settings.watch(cb)` | `settings/document-updated` 事件（`watch` 已被移除）|

其余用到的官方 API（`defineTool` / `ctx.tools.register` / `createUserMessage` /
`connection.fetch.register` / `ctx.slots.register` / `ctx.locale.*`）在 0.2.x 中均未变化。

---

**Schedule work inside a DSH session: when the time comes, a prompt is injected into the current session to wake the model up and run it.** **English** · [中文](README.md) [](#install) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-tick) The collapsed summary row above the composer — click it to manage tasks.

You want the AI to "check the build queue in 5 minutes", "summarize today's work
at 11pm", or "look at the deployment every 10 minutes" — **say it once, and it
happens on time**.

dsh-tick brings scheduling into **the current session**: at the appointed time
your prompt is injected into that session, waking the model to carry it out.
Tasks belong to the session that created them and **never leak into another one**.

---

| Mode | How you ask | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| **Delay** | "check the build queue in 2 minutes" | Runs once when the countdown ends |
| **Fixed time** | "summarize my work at 23:00 today" | Runs once at that moment |
| **Periodic** | "look at the deployment every 30 minutes" | Fires on a fixed interval until you pause or delete it |

> **Delays are capped at 30 days** (longer ones are rejected, and the error tells
> you to use fixed-time mode instead); **periodic intervals have no duration cap**.
> To wait longer, use **Fixed time** with an absolute moment.
>
> One caveat for very long intervals: timers freeze while DSH is closed, so a
> periodic task only keeps a true interval while DSH stays open.

---

```
/schedule +30m check the build queue
/schedule +2h30m summarize today's changes
/schedule every 10m look at the deployment
/schedule @2026-09-21T09:00:00+08:00 summarize what is left before standup

> Durations use `s` / `m` / `h` (e.g. `+30m`, `+2h30m`); Chinese units
> (秒 / 分钟 / 小时) work too. The `d` (days) unit is **not** supported — to wait
> more than a day, use **Fixed time** with an absolute moment instead.

---

**Pause and resume freeze the remaining time.** Pause a task with 4 minutes left,
resume it tomorrow, and it still waits 4 minutes — it will not fire immediately
just because a night passed.

**Timers freeze while DSH is closed** (delay and periodic modes). When you reopen
DSH those tasks come back **paused**, so nothing fires while you are away.
A fixed-time task whose moment passed in the meantime is marked **Overdue** and
waits for you.

The three rows above are: **Paused** (periodic), **Overdue** (fixed time, missed
across a restart), and **Paused** (delay). The red number in the sidebar footer is
the total overdue count across all sessions.

**An overdue task runs the moment you press play** — the resume action *is* "run now".

---

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tick
```

Restart DSH afterwards.

> Requires DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` or newer — **both 0.1.5 and 0.2.0 are tested**, see
> "Compatible DSH versions" below. The plugin **does not touch** `settings.yaml`;
> uninstalling removes it along with its own folder, leaving nothing behind.

---

> ⚠️ **The three gates default to conservative values** (`maxTasksPerSession: 50`,
> `maxActivePerSession: 10`, `maxInjectionsPerMinute: 1`). They exist to **catch
> runaway batches of AI-created tasks and self-injection loops** — they are not
> performance limits. If they feel tight in daily use, **just raise them**:
> they are a safety rope for you, not a hard product constraint.
>
> Every option here **takes effect immediately** — no DSH restart needed.

Controls the language of **the prompt the model sees**, independently of the UI language:

| Value | Effect |
|---|---|
| `"en"` (**default**) | English |
| `"zh"` | Chinese |
| `"custom"` | Your own templates |

Defaulting to English matches what DSH's own goal / todo / schedule plugins do:
they ship a bilingual UI, but **the prompt injected into the model is always English**.

Choosing `custom` generates a template file with full inline documentation,
**picked up on the next injection — no restart needed**. If that file is ever
corrupted, the plugin renames it to `.bad-<timestamp>`, regenerates the initial
template, and shows a one-off notice in the conversation.

---

The panel, the sidebar entry and `/schedule` replies follow **DSH's language
setting** (Settings → General → Language) — both Chinese and English are supported.
Chinese is used when no choice has been made.

> The prompt injected into the model uses `serverPromptLanguage` above and is
> **independent of the UI language**.

---

- **No custom events in the session log.** Task state lives in the plugin's own
  folder. DSH's session log enforces an event-type allowlist and offers no public
  way for a plugin to register its own types.
- **Injected messages are marked as plugin-sourced** and never impersonate the
  user. Session history always distinguishes "what you said" from "what the timer injected".
- **It does not take over the official `dsh-schedule`.** That plugin is a
  *host-wide durable reminder* system (cross-session, and it can wake cold sessions);
  this one is a *session-local task* system. They occupy different niches — running
  both leaves you and the model facing two scheduling systems.

readme.section: Appendix: why there is no in-session icon
readme.text:
**You will not see a scheduled-task icon in the session list. That is not an
oversight — the official mechanism simply cannot provide one.**

readme.section: Appendix: why there is no in-session icon
readme.text:
DSH's sidebar exposes only six slots, and the session-list area
(`sidebar.workspaces`) is a **`single`** slot already claimed by the official
workspace UI. `single` means "the highest-priority renderer wins": a second
registrant **replaces** rather than joins, so nothing can be added incrementally.
Inside an individual session row there is no slot render point at all.

readme.section: Appendix: why there is no in-session icon
readme.text:
The only workable path is DOM injection keyed on minified class names — it breaks
on every DSH release and fails silently when it does. Not worth it. The official
goal and todo plugins have no in-session icon either.

readme.section: Appendix: why there is no in-session icon
readme.text:
**The alternative: a cross-session summary entry in the sidebar footer**
(`showSidebarSummary`, off by default). Turn it on and it shows the pending and
overdue totals across all sessions; clicking it expands a cross-session list you
can jump from. It uses the official `sidebar.footer.action` slot with zero DOM
dependency — just set `showSidebarSummary` to `true` in the config above.

---

- **Timers need DSH running.** Delay and periodic modes **freeze** while DSH is
  closed; keep DSH open if you need them to follow real time.
- **No catch-up.** Rounds missed while DSH was closed are **discarded**, not
  replayed on restart.
- **Injection rate defaults to 1 per minute** (`maxInjectionsPerMinute`): if you
  set a shorter interval than that, the extra firings are throttled. Raise this
  value if you need faster.
- **The `d` (days) unit is not supported.** Use `h` (e.g. `+48h`) or **Fixed time**.

**① New `allowBackgroundWake` option (on by default)**

Previously, when a task came due while its session was **not open on screen**, the
plugin could not reach an execution target for that session — so the task only fired
later, all at once, the moment you opened the session.

Now the plugin **wakes that session** when a task comes due and delivers on time. It
goes through the official `sessionController.resolveAgent()` (contract: *Resolve or
resume one ordinary Session*), which is exactly what the official `dsh-schedule` does.

If you would rather keep things quiet and only deliver into sessions you already have
open, set `allowBackgroundWake` to `false` in `data/config.json`. Nothing is lost —
tasks stay overdue and fire as usual once you open the session.

**② Fixed the countdown not updating while collapsed**

The collapsed summary row above the composer already showed "next task in …", but only
refreshed every second while **expanded**; when collapsed the number froze until the
next poll. Now it ticks every second in both states whenever a pending task exists
(re-render only, no requests).

---

readme.section: v1.0.3 (2026-11-03) — fix injection failure on DSH 0.2.1
readme.text:
**Symptom**: after upgrading to DSH 0.2.1, a task failing at fire time aborts the
whole turn with:

```
本轮运行失败  format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind
```

readme.section: v1.0.3 (2026-11-03) — fix injection failure on DSH 0.2.1
readme.text:
**Cause**: 0.2.1 enables session format v4, which **retires the `kind: 'plugin'`
message source** in favour of a "producer-owned" kind. The plugin was injecting
`{ kind: 'plugin', plugin: 'tick' }` — exactly the shape now rejected — so
**the injection step failed**. The timer itself was fine: the task kept its
schedule and was marked done; only "deliver the prompt into the session" broke.

readme.section: v1.0.3 (2026-11-03) — fix injection failure on DSH 0.2.1
readme.text:
**Fix**: inject `{ kind: 'plugin:tick' }`. That shape is not arbitrary — it is
**the very shape DSH itself produces when migrating old data to v4** (its
migration maps `plugin:'tick'` to `plugin:tick`), so it matches official
semantics exactly. Session history still shows at a glance that this came from a
plugin, and it can **never** be mistaken for something you said.

**Compatibility** (one package, no per-version build):

readme.section: v1.0.3 (2026-11-03) — fix injection failure on DSH 0.2.1
readme.text:
| DSH version | Status |
|---|---|
| **0.1.5-rc.2** | ✅ supported (that release has no runtime check on message source) |
| **0.2.0** | ✅ supported (already reads config via `describe()`, see below) |
| **0.2.1-rc.5** | ✅ supported (the target of this fix) |

The right path is chosen by **capability detection**, not a version check:

readme.section: v1.0.3 (2026-11-03) — fix injection failure on DSH 0.2.1
readme.text:

| Reading UI language | `settings.get('locale')` | `settings.describe()` (`get` removed) |
| Language change notification | `settings.watch(cb)` | the `settings/document-updated` event (`watch` removed) |

Everything else this plugin uses (`defineTool` / `ctx.tools.register` /
`createUserMessage` / `connection.fetch.register` / `ctx.slots.register` /
`ctx.locale.*`) is unchanged in 0.2.x.
